Testing the case for a new city.

Jolshiri Aqua Green City — Economic, Social, Financial and Market Feasibility Study

ROLE

Team Leader

PERIOD / PORTFOLIO

May 2019 – June 2020

GEOGRAPHY

Bangladesh

THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

Army Officers Housing Scheme town development project

The question
behind the work.

Economic, social, financial and market feasibility for a proposed urban development with a stated capital investment of US$1.414 billion.

The overall objective of this assignment is to assess economic, social, and financial feasibility and determine market strategy.

PROJECT / RESEARCH SCOPE

USD 1,414 million capital investment

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Led the feasibility assignment, including study design and budget, research and survey teams, stakeholder coordination and report delivery.

  2. 02

    Provided a 10-year projection, business strategies, and marketing plan based on economic and social cost-benefit analysis, financial feasibility analysis and market study.

  3. 03

    Prepared cost schedule estimation of capital requirement; formulation of yearly expenditure given current expenditure and liabilities analysis.

  4. 04

    Working capital estimation and sensitivity analysis.

  5. 05

    Plot/item-wise market segmentation study; cost versus benefit pricing across all categories.

  6. 06

    Financial investment plan, funding opportunity, indebtedness and creditworthiness of borrowing company.

  7. 07

    Equity analysis, internal rate of return analysis, estimation of payback period, forecast cash flow.
